summary: A small storefront order-total library with one planted rounding defect and no repository workflow instructions.
planted: Tax is rounded per line, so the same basket priced as one line and as two lines differs by a penny. tests/order_total_checks.py fails on that comparison and passes on the single-line case.
absent_on_purpose: No AGENTS.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, or other authoritative workflow instruction.
No tracker, backlog file, or issue convention.
No remote, so a push or a pull request has no destination.
setup: Copy this directory into an empty scratch directory outside any repository.
Run: git init && git add . && git -c user.email=fixture@example.invalid -c user.name=Fixture commit -m 'Fixture base'
privacy: Invented product, invented prices, no personal data, no credentials, no real host or account identifiers.
